mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, increasing the present value of equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances during monetary easing cycles, or the 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the CPIAUCSL index above 2.0 signals accelerating inflation, reducing growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.0, or the negative return signal is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise simultaneously
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite simultaneous rises in GDPC1 and INDPRO, or the positive returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate amplifies the present value of equity cash flows, leading to significantly higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary easing cycles, the 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05), or the signal's predictive power is weak (e.g., IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the UNRATE series indicates improving labor market conditions, lowering unemployment and boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not positive in > 80% of instances with UNRATE declining, or the returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained crossing of the UNRATE index below 5.0% signals a strong labor market, enhancing economic growth prospects and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite UNRATE falling below 5.0%, or the positive returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and labor participation (PAYEMS) indices reflects robust job growth and consumer confidence, strengthening corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and PAYEMS rise simultaneously
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite simultaneous rises in GDPC1 and PAYEMS, or the positive returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous rises in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signal overheating or strong growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise simultaneously
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative during late-cycle expansions despite simultaneous rises in GDPC1 and INDPRO, or the positive returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in such periods.
